name: Crossbow
description: A crossbow lying level as held, cocked with a bolt in the groove: a wooden tiller with a deep butt, a pistol grip and a trigger lever, a prod across the nose and an iron stirrup. The light crossbow is 0.9 m long with a 0.7 m wooden prod; the heavy crossbow is 1.1 m long with a 0.9 m steel prod in iron bridles. The bolt points +x; the main hand on the grip, the off hand under the fore-stock, the butt at the shoulder.
